pages.text: GregTech replaces vanilla crafting with a long chain: steam, then electric tiers LV, MV, HV and up. Almost everything is made in machines, so open JEI (R on an item) often.

Ore: GT adds its own large ore veins. In this pack vanilla ores also generate alongside them, so early iron and coal are easy. Vanilla's large ore veins are removed.$(br2)A new world is needed to get vanilla ores in old chunks.
Progression: Steam, LV, then one voltage tier per boss. MV to ZPM machine hulls need a Cataclysm boss drop (see Pack Specifics).
